title: Aromatic scaffold-integrated hybrids of estradiol and benzoxazol-2-ones: synthesis and in vitro anticancer activity of N-substituted regioisomeric pairs
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23954-23965
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01977J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ferenc Kovács, Ildikó Huliák, Hédi Árva, Marianna Kocsis, Mónika Kiricsi, Éva Frank
Regioisomeric estradiol–benzoxazolone hybrids featuring a shared aromatic ring were efficiently synthesized, and their anticancer activities were comparatively evaluated. Derivatives bearing the 2,3-ring fusion exhibited enhanced biological activity.
